title: Muxed-account strkey with muxed id 2^63-1, the largest id a signed 64-bit integer holds
why: The boundary just below the SEP's 2^63 vector: a reader that stores ids as signed 64-bit integers must keep this one and fail loudly, not wrap, on the next.
notes: Built by xdrcheck-corpus synth from corpus/recipes/strkey/synthetic-gap-vectors.muxed-id-2-pow-63-minus-1.json. The text was encoded from the stated payload with an independent SEP-0023 encoder (version byte, payload, CRC16-XModem little-endian, RFC 4648 base32 without padding) and decoded back by the same rules; no SDK output was used. Not a probe vector; first executed by the conformance drivers.
